description:
An intermediate (blue) singletrack mountain biking and hiking trail on Jesmond Mountain that can be ridden in both directions. There is a restored fire lookout tower at the top of Jesmond Mountain that is open to the public and makes for a nice destination and provides incredible views of the surrounding area. A black diamond downhill mountain bike trail (Lost Marbles Trail) can also be accessed from the top of Jesmond Mountain.

For more details and pictures, you can also view the trail information on the Trailforks website: https://www.trailforks.com/region/jesmond-mountain-44834/map/
directions:
Trailhead Lat 51? 17.388'N , Long 121? 56.646'W

Access to the trailhead is via a four-wheel drive road. From Clinton, head southwest on Kelly Lake Road towards Kelly Lake. Travel approximately 16 km and turn right/north onto the Jesmond / Big Bar Ferry Road. Follow the Jesmond Road for about 37 km, and then turn right onto the Jesmond Lookout Forest Service Road. Follow the road about 5 km to the lower trailhead at a road junction. The road up to the fire lookout is not suitable for regular vehicular traffic from here, as the road becomes very steep and narrow, with poor visibility and traction. Park here and proceed up the road a short distance to get onto the Stairway to Heaven trail.

An alternate route to the trailhead is also signed from the north via Big Bar Road (access is via Hwy 97, north of Clinton), just a few kilometers past the Big Bar Provincial Park campsite. This route is less used and may not be suitable for all vehicle types. A four-wheel drive vehicle is recommended.

stats.Closure: The Stairway to Heaven Recreation Trail is closed due to an active wildfire in the area. For further information visit www.bcwildfire.ca
